Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . Why this role, and why now Our Chief People Officer is moving on after three and a half years. They leave behind a People Experience function that works well: predictable delivery, a capable team, a high bar on senior hiring, and a seat at the table that has been earned and respected. If you want a CPO role where the function is broken and the mandate is to fix it, this isn t it. If you want one where the function is strong and the question is what a leader can do with that platform, keep reading. The uncomfortable and energising fact about working here: our customers are HR leaders. What we do internally isn’t separate from what we sell. Our own practices are watched, asked about, and sometimes bought. It’s an incredible opportunity to innovate and create the future of work. We anticipate there may be interest from current and former customers, and we welcome it! Two things worth being upfront about; applications are visible only to our Talent Acquisition and hiring teams, never to our customer-facing teams. And, being a customer earns you no advantage and no disadvantage. We ll run the same process, set the same bar, and have the same people assessing you. What you ll own The role has several dimensions. They are listed in order of weight, and we mean the order. Run People Experience (PX) well This is a critical part of the job and the thing that has to be true before anything else matters. You ll own a strong and coherent function that delivers its cycles well and on time: performance, engagement, compensation, talent acquisition, capability, compliance across four countries. No surprises to the Exec. No escalations arriving at the CEO s desk that should have been resolved two levels down. The bar we re setting: your deputies own outcomes, not tasks. Executives go to them directly and get good answers. You design the org ahead of the strategy rather than in response to it, so that when the business changes direction the structure is already close to right. Your team respects you, and your senior hires raise the average. You ll be a trusted sounding board to Caroline and the Exec on structure, senior hires, compensation and the calls that don t have clean answers. Be credible in the market and with customers Our customers are your peers. That is a commercial asset, and we want you to use it. You ll speak at our global events and in the market, join customer conversations, and support Sales and Customer Experience in rooms where a practitioner s view might land differently to a vendor s. Over time we d like Sales to be asking for you by name and customers backchannelling you for advice on their own problems. To be clear about the bar: we are not hiring a keynote speaker. You don’t need to be a world-class presenter, and polish is not what we re screening for. This partnership is critical to achieving pipeline and growth targets across the region. Team leadership and development: Lead, mentor and develop a high-performing North America marketing team, building a culture of collaboration, accountability and excellence. AI-driven execution: Identify where AI tools can accelerate campaign delivery, content production and reporting, and embed them into the team s ways of working. AI fluency and change management: Build the team s fluency with AI tools and lead the change management required to adopt new AI-enabled workflows. Collaboration with the Growth Marketing team: Partner with your fellow leaders in the Growth marketing team, which includes demand generation, ABM, the website, lifecycle marketing, SDR and regional leaders from EMEA and APAC, to bring global programmes to life in North America and represent the region s priorities back to the global team. Alignment with global marketing: Partner with the broader global marketing organisation, which owns brand, comms, PR, social, and solutions marketing,. Event strategy: Own the strategy and execution of regional events, trade shows and webinars, creating brand experiences that generate high-quality leads. Budget optimisation: Manage the North America marketing budget, optimising the allocation of resources and investing where it will generate the best return. Performance and data-driven decisions: Establish KPIs for marketing programmes and use data-driven insight to test, adjust and continuously improve the regional strategy Who you are: Experience: 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, predominantly in enterprise software or SaaS, with a strong track record in regional marketing and team leadership. We re looking for a Senior People Science Analyst to join our global People Science Analytics team on a 12-month fixed term contract. You ll listen closely to customers, bring clarity to methodology and reporting, and collaborate with HR leaders, customer-facing People Scientists, Customer Success Managers and Account Managers to develop studies and insight reports for clients and the wider public.
